item.title: Should American Presidents Have Military Uniforms?
item.description: Though the president of the United States has never worn a military uniform, Richard Nixon briefly gave the Secret Service elaborate—and widely-derided—dress uniforms. The post Should American Presidents Have Military Uniforms? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Maduro’s Capture Won’t Disrupt Global Oil Markets
item.description: Maduro has been captured, but the lion’s share of the impact will be in the political and diplomatic arenas of world politics. Early on January 3, US forces removed Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro from the country and flew him to New York for arraignment on charges related to drug and arms trafficking.
